title: Have I Been Pwned Breach Records Exposed Leaderboard
dataSources: Life service health (`lifeos:service`), personal scorecards (`lifeos:score`), breach notifications (`hibp:breach`), location visits (`location:visit`), runbook checklists (`runbook:checklist`), and Home Assistant outage events (`homeassistant:event`).
app: Apple and Google location exports, Have I Been Pwned breach alerts, Todoist-style personal runbooks, and Home Assistant outage events streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hibp:breach records_exposed=*
| stats sum(records_exposed) as total_value, avg(records_exposed) as avg_value by account_label
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks account label values by total and average records exposed across Have I Been Pwned breach events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `records_exposed` values for each Have I Been Pwned breach event and review total and average records exposed by account label.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total records exposed.

references.title: Have I Been Pwned API v3

grandmaExplanation: It flags which account label shows the biggest records exposed numbers in your Have I Been Pwned breach data.
